speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Master Shakespeare? Ambrose Kettleby. From Somerset House, among the hampers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Master Kettleby. I hear you. I am at the Theatre, and the yard is quieter than your hampers.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: The court removes to Richmond today, and my lord with it. Master Heminges's question has reached me by three hands, or I should not have known to call.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am glad of the three hands. Who signs, now Sir Thomas is dead?

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Sir Thomas's place is not filled. His lady must render his accounts before any man can sign a new one. The Chamber will pay nobody anything till then.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My lord knows the players eat daily. If we are sent for, what becomes of that?

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: You will be sent for. Whether you will be paid for is a question for another office. My lord says the Queen's debt is the best in England, and he says it with oaths I shall not carry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the king play. Has he heard what we played?

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: My lord has heard of it from four persons and disliked none of the reports. That is all I am to say.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will look to them. You have had a noisy place to speak from, and I thank you for it.
